description: This file defines a client-side API function 'getTenantUsersSummary' that fetches and normalizes a summary of users per tenant from a backend endpoint. It imports an external function for strict data retrieval and provides an exported function for use elsewhere in the application.

methods.name: getTenantUsersSummary()
methods.description: Fetches the tenant users summary, normalizes the response shape, and returns an object with 'items' and 'total' count. Handles errors by logging and throwing a new error message.
